description: We are an ambitious technical team participating in the 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge, currently developing an immersive 3D interactive space exploration and simulation game. We are looking for passionate members to join our team, specifically seeking skills in game development, web technologies, UI/UX design, and creative problem-solving. Join us to build an innovative solution!
summary:
Project Ares: The Martian Genesis is an interactive 3D web-based survival and simulation game developed for the NASA Space Apps Challenge. The project addresses Martian exploration and habitation challenges by combining gamified survival mechanics with real NASA scientific data. 

Players start in a custom hangar to upgrade their spacecraft and astronaut suits using an earned points system. After an emergency space flight failure forces an emergency landing in the Jezero Crater, players must survive the harsh Martian environment and complete five core scientific missions: deploying solar array networks, extracting subsurface water ice (ISRU), securing lava tube shelters against radiation, decontaminating toxic perchlorates for greenhouse agriculture, and transmitting proof-of-life signals back to Earth. 

The project bridges entertainment and education, demonstrating how future astronauts can sustainably colonize Mars using In-Situ Resource Utilization and authentic planetary science.
details:
Project Ares: The Martian Genesis is an immersive 3D survival and simulation game built for the NASA Space Apps Challenge using HTML5, JavaScript, and Three.js

What it does: It simulates a complete journey from a custom hangar where players upgrade their spaceship and astronaut suits, to an emergency space flight landing in the Jezero Crater, followed by five core survival and scientific missions on Mars

Scientific Accuracy: The game incorporates real NASA planetary science, addressing atmospheric thinness, Martian gravity (0.38g), subsurface water ice extraction (ISRU), lava tube radiation shielding, perchlorate soil decontamination for greenhouse agriculture, and communication array transmission

Tools & Technologies: Developed using Three.js for 3D rendering, custom PBR textures, and web technologies for instant cross-platform playability. It bridges entertainment and scientific education, demonstrating sustainable human habitation on Mars.
